title: Your LLM's 'Persona' Is a Feature, Not a Bug: Why Persona Cartography Changes Everything for Control & Safety
angle: Forget generic alignment — 'Persona Cartography' reveals how direct control over LLM personality traits, from conscientiousness to emotional stability, is the real game-changer for deploying safer, more predictable, and more effective AI, especially in sensitive applications.
rationale: This isn't just about 'making LLMs nicer'; it's about engineering specific, predictable behaviors, which is a critical, overlooked aspect of AI deployment and safety.

source_articles.title: Persona Cartography: Charting Language Model Personality Traits in Weight Space
